mapper.select: /** 매장코드에 매칭된 대리점조회 **/ SELECT KT_ORG_ID /* KT조직ID */ , ORGN_ID /* 조직 ID */ , ORGN_NM /* 조직명 */ FROM ORG_ORGN_INFO_MST WHERE ORGN_ID IN ( SELECT B.AGNCY_ORGN_ID FROM ORG_ORGN_INFO_MST A, ORG_AGNCY_SHOP_REL B WHERE A.ORGN_ID = B.SHOP_ORGN_ID AND B.REL_END_DT = '99991231235959' AND B.REL_STAT_CD = 'CFM' AND B.SHOP_ORGN_ID = #{shopOrgnId} -- 파라미터 : 로그인 사용자 조직 ( ex. V000001083 ) ) AND ORGN_STAT_CD = '4' -- /* CMN0005 - 1 : 등록, 2 : 폐기, 3 : 청산, 4 : 가동, 5 : 정리 */ AND TYPE_CD = '20' -- /* CMN0003 - 10 : 본사조직, 20 : 대리점, 30 : 판매점 */ AND ORGN_LVL_CD = '10' -- /* CMN0006 - 1 : 본사, 2 : 사업부, 3 : 지원부, 4 : 파트, 5 : 영업, 10 : 대리점, 20 : 판매점 */

SELECT /*AppformMapper.requestOsstCount */ COUNT(1) FROM MCP_REQUEST_OSST@DL_MCP T1 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.MVNO_ORD_NO = LPAD(#{mvnoOrdNo}, 14, '0') AND T1.PRGR_STAT_CD = #{prgrStatCd}
AND T1.RSLT_CD = #{rsltCd}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS YEAR_ACT_CNT FROM (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_TYPE, CUST_IDNT_NO_IND_CD, CUSTOMER_SSN, DRIVR_LICNS_NO FROM MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO WHERE (CUSTOMER_SSN = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) OR DRIVR_LICNS_NO = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) OR TAX_ID = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn})) ) T1 INNER JOIN MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO T2 ON T2.CUSTOMER_ID = T1.CUSTOMER_ID AND (T2.SUB_STATUS = 'A' OR T2.SUB_STATUS = 'S' OR ( T2.SUB_STATUS = 'C' AND SUBSTR(NVL(T2.SUB_STATUS_DATE, '99991231'), 1, 6) > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-365, 'YYYYMMDD') ) )

SELECT COUNT(*) AS YEAR_CAN_CNT FROM (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_TYPE, CUST_IDNT_NO_IND_CD, CUSTOMER_SSN, DRIVR_LICNS_NO FROM MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO WHERE (CUSTOMER_SSN = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) OR DRIVR_LICNS_NO = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) OR TAX_ID = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn})) ) T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, SUB_STATUS, LST_COM_ACTV_DATE, SUB_STATUS_DATE FROM MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO WHERE SUB_STATUS = 'C' ) T2 ON T2.CUSTOMER_ID = T1.CUSTOMER_ID AND T2.LST_COM_ACTV_DATE > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-365, 'YYYYMMDD')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS THIS_MONTH_ACT_CNT FROM (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_TYPE, CUST_IDNT_NO_IND_CD, CUSTOMER_SSN, DRIVR_LICNS_NO FROM MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO WHERE (CUSTOMER_SSN = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) OR DRIVR_LICNS_NO = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) OR TAX_ID = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn})) ) T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO WHERE SUB_STATUS <> 'C' ) T2 ON T2.CUSTOMER_ID = T1.CUSTOMER_ID AND SUBSTR(NVL(T2.LST_COM_ACTV_DATE, '99991231'), 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS DELINQ_STATUS_CNT FROM (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_TYPE, CUST_IDNT_NO_IND_CD, CUSTOMER_SSN, DRIVR_LICNS_NO FROM MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO WHERE (CUSTOMER_SSN = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) OR DRIVR_LICNS_NO = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) OR TAX_ID = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn})) ) T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, BAN, CONTRACT_NUM FROM MSP_JUO_BAN_MAPP_INFO WHERE APP_END_DATE = '99991231000000' ) T3 ON T3.CUSTOMER_ID = T1.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN (SELECT BAN FROM MSP_JUO_BAN_INFO WHERE COL_DELINQ_STATUS = 'D' ) T4 ON T4.BAN = T3.BAN

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOT_ACT_CNT FROM (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_TYPE, CUST_IDNT_NO_IND_CD, CUSTOMER_SSN, DRIVR_LICNS_NO FROM MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO WHERE (CUSTOMER_SSN = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) OR DRIVR_LICNS_NO = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) OR TAX_ID = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn})) ) T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO WHERE SUB_STATUS <> 'C' ) T2 ON T2.CUSTOMER_ID = T1.CUSTOMER_ID
